data.title: 提弗洛斯 · 工坊长桌擦拭保养弓弦
data.action: 俯身在工坊工作台前给弓弦上蜡检查羽箭
data.lighting: 工坊悬吊暖白台灯聚焦照射木桌
data.description: 工坊里弥漫着松脂蜡与金属保养油的淡香。系着橄榄绿帆布围裙的提弗洛斯把袖口卷到小臂，低头仔细检查箭羽的平衡度，察觉你走进来才抬头笑了一声，扬手示意你递过桌角的校准尺。
data.promptProse: Seated at a cluttered wooden workbench under a warm hanging lamp, Typhoeus inspects the fletching of an arrow while her bow and maintenance tools rest nearby, glancing up at the viewer with a quiet smile.
data.animaCaption: She sits at the warmly lit wooden workbench holding an arrow for inspection, looking up at the viewer with an easy focused smile.
